# Metrics reference

Contract `factorymeter/v1`. 66 metrics over 7 stations and the line as a whole.

Every number factorymeter reports is listed here with its exact definition. The same list is in [`metrics.json`](metrics.json) for programs, and `factorymeter metrics` prints it.

## The line

Work passes through seven stations, in this order.

| Station | Id | What moves through it | What happens there |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Spec](#spec) | `spec` | ticket | A ticket is written and waits for someone to start on it. |
| [Code](#code) | `code` | change | The change is written. |
| [CI](#ci) | `ci` | CI round | The checks run on each push to a change. One CI round is every run on one commit of a change. |
| [Verify](#verify) | `verify` | change | The change is proved on a running environment before it merges. |
| [Review](#review) | `review` | change | Another person reads the change and approves it or sends it back. |
| [Merge](#merge) | `merge` | change | The approved change lands on the main branch. |
| [Release](#release) | `release` | change | The merged change reaches production. |

## How to read a metric id

An id is `station.kind` or `station.kind.stat`, for example `review.wait.p50`: at the review station, the wait, the median. The station part is one of the seven station ids, or `line` for a number about the whole line.

Every station is asked the same questions, so a station is read the same way wherever it is.

| Kind | What it answers |
|---|---|
| `flow` | How many items leave the station each week. |
| `wait` | How long an item waits before the station starts on it. |
| `work` | How long the station works on an item. |
| `rework` | The share of items the station sends back or has to redo. |
| `queue` | How many items stand at the station at the end of the period, and how old the oldest is. |
| `held` | The hours items spend at the station, wait and work together. The constraint is the station with the most. |
| `other` | Numbers that fit none of the five. |

A station that cannot observe one of them says why, and has no such metric. The stat part is `p50` for the median, `p90` for the 90th percentile, `oldest` for the age of the oldest item, `total` and `share` for the held hours.

## Units

| Unit | How to read it |
|---|---|
| `per_week` | Items per week: the count in the period divided by the length of the period in weeks. |
| `hours` | Hours of wall-clock time. Nights and weekends count. |
| `share` | A share between 0 and 1. 0.25 is 25 percent. |
| `count` | A plain count at one moment. |
| `lines` | Lines of code. |

## Rules that hold for every metric

- A definition says "the period". For the value of a metric that is the whole window of the report, 13 weeks unless asked otherwise. For one point of its history it is one week.
- A station's numbers are counted when they happen, not when the change merges. A wait counts in the period it ended, and work in the period the item left the station. A change that waited four weeks for review and got it this week counts this week, at the review station, whether or not it has merged yet.
- The numbers about the whole line are measured over the changes merged in the period.
- Queue numbers are not measured over a period. They are the state at the end of it.
- A median, a percentile or a share drawn from fewer than 5 items is still reported, and marked thin. No trend is called on a thin value.
- Every time is wall-clock time. Nights and weekends count, because the work waits through them.
- Changes by automation, such as dependency bumps and release bots, are reported as their own class and are left out of every number about the whole line.
- A metric id never changes meaning. When a definition has to change, the metric gets a new id and the old one stays or is removed in a new contract version.

## The constraint

The constraint is the station that holds work the longest. For each station that counts, factorymeter adds up the hours the items that left it in the period spent there, each item capped at the station's 90th percentile, and names the station with the largest share. It names none when fewer than 5 changes merged in the period.

## Spec

<a id="spec"></a>A ticket is written and waits for someone to start on it.

- Item: ticket.
- Arrives: The ticket is created.
- Leaves: Work starts: the ticket first moves to a started state, or its first linked change is opened, whichever comes first.
- Measured from: `ticket` records.
- Constraint: the station is never named the constraint. A backlog holds tickets on purpose, often for months. Counting that as waiting would name spec the constraint in every repository.
- No `held` number: Spec is left out of the constraint, so its hours are not added up.
- No `work` number: Writing a ticket leaves no start time.

| Id | Name | Unit | Better when | Minimum sample | Cut by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `spec.flow` | Tickets started | `per_week` | higher | none | `repo` |
| `spec.wait.p50` | Wait for work to start, median | `hours` | lower | 5 | `repo` |
| `spec.wait.p90` | Wait for work to start, 90th percentile | `hours` | lower | 5 | `repo` |
| `spec.rework` | Tickets reopened | `share` | lower | 5 | `repo` |
| `spec.queue` | Tickets not started | `count` | lower | none | `repo` |
| `spec.queue.oldest` | Tickets not started, age of the oldest | `hours` | lower | none | `repo` |

- `spec.flow`: Tickets that work started on in the period. Work starts when the ticket first moves to a started state or its first linked change is opened, whichever comes first. The count is divided by the length of the period in weeks.
- `spec.wait.p50`: Hours from a ticket being created to work starting on it, over the tickets that work started on in the period. The median.
- `spec.wait.p90`: Hours from a ticket being created to work starting on it, over the tickets that work started on in the period. The 90th percentile: one item in ten waited longer.
- `spec.rework`: Share of the tickets finished in the period that had been finished before and were opened again.
- `spec.queue`: Tickets that are open and that nobody has started, at the end of the period. Cancelled tickets are left out.
- `spec.queue.oldest`: Hours since it was created, for the item that has stood longest in this queue at the end of the period. Tickets that are open and that nobody has started, at the end of the period. Cancelled tickets are left out.

## Code

<a id="code"></a>The change is written.

- Item: change.
- Arrives: The first commit of the change is written or the change is opened, whichever is earlier.
- Leaves: The change is marked ready for review. A change opened ready leaves when it is opened.
- Measured from: `change` records.
- Constraint: the station can be named the constraint.
- No `wait` number: Code has no queue of its own. A ticket waiting for someone to start waits at spec.

| Id | Name | Unit | Better when | Minimum sample | Cut by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `code.flow` | PRs made ready | `per_week` | higher | none | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `code.work.p50` | Time to write a PR, median | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `code.work.p90` | Time to write a PR, 90th percentile | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `code.rework` | PRs abandoned | `share` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `code.queue` | PRs in draft | `count` | lower | none | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `code.queue.oldest` | PRs in draft, age of the oldest | `hours` | lower | none | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `code.held.total` | Hours a week held at code | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `code.held.share` | Share of the line's time held at code | `share` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |

- `code.flow`: Changes marked ready for review in the period. A change opened ready counts when it is opened. The count is divided by the length of the period in weeks.
- `code.work.p50`: Hours from the start of a change to it being marked ready for review, over the changes marked ready in the period. The start is the first commit or the opening of the change, whichever is earlier. Merge commits, and commits written more than 90 days before the change was opened, do not count: they are history the change carries, or a wrong date. The median.
- `code.work.p90`: Hours from the start of a change to it being marked ready for review, over the changes marked ready in the period. The start is the first commit or the opening of the change, whichever is earlier. Merge commits, and commits written more than 90 days before the change was opened, do not count: they are history the change carries, or a wrong date. The 90th percentile: one item in ten took longer.
- `code.rework`: Share of the changes closed in the period that were closed without merging.
- `code.queue`: Changes that are open and still a draft at the end of the period.
- `code.queue.oldest`: Hours since it was opened, for the item that has stood longest in this queue at the end of the period. Changes that are open and still a draft at the end of the period.
- `code.held.total`: Hours the items that left the code station in the period spent there, wait and work together, per week. Each item is capped at the 90th percentile of the station, so one item that sat for months cannot decide the total. Time with a CI run in flight is counted at ci and taken out of the station the change stood at, so no hour is counted twice.
- `code.held.share`: The held hours of the code station divided by the held hours of every station that counts for the constraint. The station with the largest share is the constraint.

## CI

<a id="ci"></a>The checks run on each push to a change. One CI round is every run on one commit of a change.

- Item: CI round.
- Arrives: The first run on the commit is created.
- Leaves: The last run on the commit finishes.
- Measured from: `change`, `ci_run` records.
- Constraint: the station can be named the constraint.
- No `queue` number: A CI round lasts minutes. A count of rounds in flight at the end of a week says nothing about the week.

| Id | Name | Unit | Better when | Minimum sample | Cut by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ci.flow` | CI rounds | `per_week` | higher | none | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `ci.wait.p50` | Wait for a runner, median | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `ci.wait.p90` | Wait for a runner, 90th percentile | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `ci.work.p50` | CI round time, median | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `ci.work.p90` | CI round time, 90th percentile | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `ci.rework` | CI rounds that failed | `share` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `ci.held.total` | Hours a week held at ci | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `ci.held.share` | Share of the line's time held at ci | `share` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |

- `ci.flow`: CI rounds that finished in the period. A CI round is every run on one commit of a change. The runs a merge queue starts for a change are a round of their own. Skipped and cancelled runs are left out. The count is divided by the length of the period in weeks.
- `ci.wait.p50`: Hours from the first run of a CI round being created to the first run starting, over the rounds that finished in the period. The median.
- `ci.wait.p90`: Hours from the first run of a CI round being created to the first run starting, over the rounds that finished in the period. The 90th percentile: one item in ten waited longer.
- `ci.work.p50`: Hours with at least one run in flight, from the first run of a CI round starting to the last one finishing, over the rounds that finished in the period. The median.
- `ci.work.p90`: Hours with at least one run in flight, from the first run of a CI round starting to the last one finishing, over the rounds that finished in the period. The 90th percentile: one item in ten took longer.
- `ci.rework`: Share of the CI rounds finished in the period in which a run failed, timed out or was run again.
- `ci.held.total`: Hours the items that left the ci station in the period spent there, wait and work together, per week. Each item is capped at the 90th percentile of the station, so one item that sat for months cannot decide the total. Time with a CI run in flight is counted at ci and taken out of the station the change stood at, so no hour is counted twice.
- `ci.held.share`: The held hours of the ci station divided by the held hours of every station that counts for the constraint. The station with the largest share is the constraint.

## Verify

<a id="verify"></a>The change is proved on a running environment before it merges.

- Item: change.
- Arrives: A commit of the change is deployed to an environment that is not production.
- Leaves: That deployment reports success.
- Measured from: `change`, `deploy` records.
- Constraint: the station can be named the constraint.
- No `queue` number: Nothing records that a change is waiting for an environment.

| Id | Name | Unit | Better when | Minimum sample | Cut by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `verify.flow` | PRs verified | `per_week` | higher | none | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `verify.wait.p50` | Wait for an environment, median | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `verify.wait.p90` | Wait for an environment, 90th percentile | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `verify.work.p50` | Time to bring the PR up, median | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `verify.work.p90` | Time to bring the PR up, 90th percentile | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `verify.rework` | Verify deployments that failed | `share` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `verify.held.total` | Hours a week held at verify | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `verify.held.share` | Share of the line's time held at verify | `share` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |

- `verify.flow`: Changes whose first deployment to an environment that is not production reported success in the period. The count is divided by the length of the period in weeks.
- `verify.wait.p50`: Hours from a commit of a change being written to its deployment to an environment that is not production being created, over the deployments created in the period. The median.
- `verify.wait.p90`: Hours from a commit of a change being written to its deployment to an environment that is not production being created, over the deployments created in the period. The 90th percentile: one item in ten waited longer.
- `verify.work.p50`: Hours from such a deployment being created to it reporting success, over the deployments that reported success in the period. The median.
- `verify.work.p90`: Hours from such a deployment being created to it reporting success, over the deployments that reported success in the period. The 90th percentile: one item in ten took longer.
- `verify.rework`: Share of the deployments of changes to an environment that is not production, finished in the period, that reported a failure or an error.
- `verify.held.total`: Hours the items that left the verify station in the period spent there, wait and work together, per week. Each item is capped at the 90th percentile of the station, so one item that sat for months cannot decide the total. Time with a CI run in flight is counted at ci and taken out of the station the change stood at, so no hour is counted twice.
- `verify.held.share`: The held hours of the verify station divided by the held hours of every station that counts for the constraint. The station with the largest share is the constraint.

## Review

<a id="review"></a>Another person reads the change and approves it or sends it back.

- Item: change.
- Arrives: The change is marked ready for review.
- Leaves: The last approval before the merge. A change that merges after a review with no approval leaves at the merge. A change nobody else reviewed skips the station.
- Measured from: `change` records.
- Constraint: the station can be named the constraint.

| Id | Name | Unit | Better when | Minimum sample | Cut by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `review.flow` | PRs reviewed | `per_week` | higher | none | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `review.wait.p50` | Wait for first review, median | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `review.wait.p90` | Wait for first review, 90th percentile | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `review.work.p50` | First review to approval, median | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `review.work.p90` | First review to approval, 90th percentile | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `review.rework` | PRs sent back in review | `share` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `review.queue` | PRs waiting for first review | `count` | lower | none | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `review.queue.oldest` | PRs waiting for first review, age of the oldest | `hours` | lower | none | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `review.held.total` | Hours a week held at review | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `review.held.share` | Share of the line's time held at review | `share` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `review.skipped` | PRs merged with no review | `share` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |

- `review.flow`: Merged changes that left review in the period. A change leaves review at its last approval before the merge, or at the merge when it was reviewed and never approved. A review counts when a person other than the author wrote it. Reviews by bots and by the author do not count. The count is divided by the length of the period in weeks.
- `review.wait.p50`: Hours from a change being marked ready for review to its first review, over the changes that got their first review in the period. A review that lands while the change is a draft gives a wait of zero. A review counts when a person other than the author wrote it. Reviews by bots and by the author do not count. The median.
- `review.wait.p90`: Hours from a change being marked ready for review to its first review, over the changes that got their first review in the period. A review that lands while the change is a draft gives a wait of zero. A review counts when a person other than the author wrote it. Reviews by bots and by the author do not count. The 90th percentile: one item in ten waited longer.
- `review.work.p50`: Hours from the first review of a change to it leaving review, over the merged changes that left review in the period. A review counts when a person other than the author wrote it. Reviews by bots and by the author do not count. The median.
- `review.work.p90`: Hours from the first review of a change to it leaving review, over the merged changes that left review in the period. A review counts when a person other than the author wrote it. Reviews by bots and by the author do not count. The 90th percentile: one item in ten took longer.
- `review.rework`: Share of the merged changes that left review in the period on which a reviewer requested changes, or which got a new commit after the first review. Merge commits do not count.
- `review.queue`: Changes that are open, ready for review and without a review at the end of the period. A review counts when a person other than the author wrote it. Reviews by bots and by the author do not count.
- `review.queue.oldest`: Hours since it was marked ready for review, for the item that has stood longest in this queue at the end of the period. Changes that are open, ready for review and without a review at the end of the period. A review counts when a person other than the author wrote it. Reviews by bots and by the author do not count.
- `review.held.total`: Hours the items that left the review station in the period spent there, wait and work together, per week. Each item is capped at the 90th percentile of the station, so one item that sat for months cannot decide the total. Time with a CI run in flight is counted at ci and taken out of the station the change stood at, so no hour is counted twice.
- `review.held.share`: The held hours of the review station divided by the held hours of every station that counts for the constraint. The station with the largest share is the constraint.
- `review.skipped`: Share of the changes merged in the period that no other person reviewed before the merge. A review counts when a person other than the author wrote it. Reviews by bots and by the author do not count.

## Merge

<a id="merge"></a>The approved change lands on the main branch.

- Item: change.
- Arrives: The change leaves review. A change nobody else reviewed arrives when it is marked ready for review.
- Leaves: The change merges.
- Measured from: `change` records.
- Constraint: the station can be named the constraint.
- No `work` number: A merge is one click. It has no start time apart from its end.

| Id | Name | Unit | Better when | Minimum sample | Cut by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `merge.flow` | PRs merged | `per_week` | higher | none | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `merge.wait.p50` | Wait to merge, median | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `merge.wait.p90` | Wait to merge, 90th percentile | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `merge.rework` | Merges reverted | `share` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `merge.queue` | PRs approved and not merged | `count` | lower | none | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `merge.queue.oldest` | PRs approved and not merged, age of the oldest | `hours` | lower | none | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `merge.held.total` | Hours a week held at merge | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `merge.held.share` | Share of the line's time held at merge | `share` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |

- `merge.flow`: Changes merged in the period. The count is divided by the length of the period in weeks.
- `merge.wait.p50`: Hours from a change arriving at merge to it merging, over the changes merged in the period. A change arrives when it leaves review. A change nobody else reviewed arrives when it is marked ready for review. The median.
- `merge.wait.p90`: Hours from a change arriving at merge to it merging, over the changes merged in the period. A change arrives when it leaves review. A change nobody else reviewed arrives when it is marked ready for review. The 90th percentile: one item in ten waited longer.
- `merge.rework`: Share of the changes merged in the period that a later change reverted. A change reverts another when its description says so in the words the code host writes for a revert.
- `merge.queue`: Changes that are open and approved at the end of the period, with no request for changes after the last approval.
- `merge.queue.oldest`: Hours since its last approval, for the item that has stood longest in this queue at the end of the period. Changes that are open and approved at the end of the period, with no request for changes after the last approval.
- `merge.held.total`: Hours the items that left the merge station in the period spent there, wait and work together, per week. Each item is capped at the 90th percentile of the station, so one item that sat for months cannot decide the total. Time with a CI run in flight is counted at ci and taken out of the station the change stood at, so no hour is counted twice.
- `merge.held.share`: The held hours of the merge station divided by the held hours of every station that counts for the constraint. The station with the largest share is the constraint.

## Release

<a id="release"></a>The merged change reaches production.

- Item: change.
- Arrives: The change merges.
- Leaves: The first production deploy that holds it. A change merged before the first production deploy in the store is not counted.
- Measured from: `change`, `deploy` records.
- Constraint: the station can be named the constraint.

| Id | Name | Unit | Better when | Minimum sample | Cut by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `release.flow` | PRs released | `per_week` | higher | none | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `release.wait.p50` | Wait for a release, median | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `release.wait.p90` | Wait for a release, 90th percentile | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `release.work.p50` | Deploy time, median | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `release.work.p90` | Deploy time, 90th percentile | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `release.rework` | Deploys that failed | `share` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `release.queue` | PRs merged and not released | `count` | lower | none | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `release.queue.oldest` | PRs merged and not released, age of the oldest | `hours` | lower | none | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `release.held.total` | Hours a week held at release | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `release.held.share` | Share of the line's time held at release | `share` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `release.deploys` | Production deploys | `per_week` | higher | none | `repo` |

- `release.flow`: Merged changes that reached production in the period. A production deploy of the commit a merge left on its branch holds the changes merged into that branch up to that merge. Of any other deploy only the time is known, and it is taken to hold the changes merged before it started. The count is divided by the length of the period in weeks.
- `release.wait.p50`: Hours from a change merging to the start of the production deploy that shipped it, over the changes that reached production in the period. A production deploy of the commit a merge left on its branch holds the changes merged into that branch up to that merge. Of any other deploy only the time is known, and it is taken to hold the changes merged before it started. The median.
- `release.wait.p90`: Hours from a change merging to the start of the production deploy that shipped it, over the changes that reached production in the period. A production deploy of the commit a merge left on its branch holds the changes merged into that branch up to that merge. Of any other deploy only the time is known, and it is taken to hold the changes merged before it started. The 90th percentile: one item in ten waited longer.
- `release.work.p50`: Hours from a production deploy being created to it reporting success, over the production deploys that reported success in the period. The median.
- `release.work.p90`: Hours from a production deploy being created to it reporting success, over the production deploys that reported success in the period. The 90th percentile: one item in ten took longer.
- `release.rework`: Share of the production deploys finished in the period that reported a failure or an error.
- `release.queue`: Changes that are merged and that no production deploy has followed, at the end of the period.
- `release.queue.oldest`: Hours since it merged, for the item that has stood longest in this queue at the end of the period. Changes that are merged and that no production deploy has followed, at the end of the period.
- `release.held.total`: Hours the items that left the release station in the period spent there, wait and work together, per week. Each item is capped at the 90th percentile of the station, so one item that sat for months cannot decide the total. Time with a CI run in flight is counted at ci and taken out of the station the change stood at, so no hour is counted twice.
- `release.held.share`: The held hours of the release station divided by the held hours of every station that counts for the constraint. The station with the largest share is the constraint.
- `release.deploys`: Production deploys created in the period, per week. A deploy is a deployment to an environment whose name says production, or a published release when the repository has no such deployment.

## The whole line

<a id="line"></a>Numbers about the line from end to end.

| Id | Name | Unit | Better when | Minimum sample | Cut by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `line.flow` | PRs merged | `per_week` | higher | none | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `line.lead.p50` | Open to merge, median | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `line.lead.p90` | Open to merge, 90th percentile | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `line.delivery.p50` | Start to production, median | `hours` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |
| `line.agent_share` | Disclosed agent share | `share` | neither | 5 | `repo` |
| `line.size.p50` | Lines changed, median | `lines` | lower | 5 | `class`, `agent`, `repo` |

- `line.flow`: Changes merged in the period, per week. For the whole line this counts changes by agents and by people. Automation is left out.
- `line.lead.p50`: Hours from a change being opened to it merging, over the changes merged in the period. The median.
- `line.lead.p90`: Hours from a change being opened to it merging, over the changes merged in the period. The 90th percentile: one change in ten took longer.
- `line.delivery.p50`: Hours from the start of a change to the production deploy that shipped it, over the changes that reached production in the period. The start is the first commit or the opening of the change, whichever is earlier. Merge commits, and commits written more than 90 days before the change was opened, do not count: they are history the change carries, or a wrong date. The median. A production deploy of the commit a merge left on its branch holds the changes merged into that branch up to that merge. Of any other deploy only the time is known, and it is taken to hold the changes merged before it started.
- `line.agent_share`: Changes by agents divided by changes by agents and by people, over the changes merged in the period. Automation is left out of both sides. It is a floor: an agent that leaves no trace counts as a person.
- `line.size.p50`: Lines added plus lines deleted, over the changes merged in the period. The median.
